summary: Complete Q1 Explore review of 114 approved. The Explore now defines a closed, Core-validated Lean Run contract; all ResultRef categories are Core-derived through compatible run-result and artifact constructors; review input is content-bound without self-reference; non-Run kinds and paths are Core-owned; and verificationSummaryRef is both Run-stable and lifecycle-aligned.
